description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order to declare an Excise Duty on Motor Vehicles for the transport of goods shall be Payable w.e.f. 07.12.2016
reasoning: This gazette content focuses on legal/regulatory matters by publishing an order under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No. 13 of 1989. It establishes new excise duty rates on specific goods (motor vehicles for transport of goods) through a statutory instrument. While it mentions Minister Ravi Karunanayake, it does so only in his capacity to exercise statutory powers, without detailing his portfolio responsibilities or making personnel changes. The core content is regulatory in nature, establishing new tax rates through legal authority.
